why: Hebrews 9:2-8 describes the holy place of the tent Moses set up in the wilderness, not a room in the temple in Jerusalem, where Bible Atlas puts its point, so no dot is drawn.
Bible Atlas puts its Red Sea point in the open southern Red Sea; the sea Israel crossed on leaving Egypt (11:29) lay east of Egypt, far to the north of that point.
12:22 speaks of Mount Zion and the heavenly Jerusalem, the city of the living God that the readers have come near to in worship, not the earthly city where Bible Atlas puts its point.
